prop_desc: FREE THE TOLL BRIDGE OVER TENNESSEE RIVER BETWEEN FLORENCE AND SHEFFIELD

prop_desc: ALL REMAINING STATE CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENTS BESIDES 1 AND 2

prop_desc: GIVE EVERY COUNTY A STATE SENATOR AND ENLARGE LEGISLATURE

prop_desc: STATE BONDS OF $4,000,000 FOR STATE HOSPITAL FOR INSANE AND PARTLOW SCHOOL
notes_endorse: ENDORSED. 'IT SHOULD BE RATIFIED.'

prop_desc: BONDS FOR GENERAL HOSPITALS, TUBERCULOSIS HOSPITALS AND HEALTH CENTERS UP TO $2,000,000
notes_endorse: ENDORSED. ANNISTON WOULD FIND MUCH NEEDED RELIEF UNDER THIS MEASURE.

prop_desc: ALLOW TUSCALOOSA COUNTY GOVERNMENT TO ISSUE BONDS FOR NEW COURT HOUSE
notes_endorse: ENDORSED. 'THAT SEEMS FAIR ENOUGH.'

prop_desc: ALLOW GADSDEN CITY GOVERNMENT TO LEVY ADDITIONAL 1 PER CENT TAX ON PROPERTY TO RETIRE BONDED INDEBTEDNESS
notes_endorse: ENDORSED. HAD SUPPORT OF ETOWAH COUNTY DELEGATION IN STATE LEGISLATURE.

prop_desc: LAUDERDALE COUNTY - PREVENT LEGISLATURE FROM TAKING REPRISALS AGAINST OFFICEHOLDERS BY ABOLISHING JOBS
notes_endorse: ENDORSED. PAPER AGREES WITH ASSOCIATION OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS THAT IT SHOULD BE ADOPTED. HAS STATEWIDE SIGNIFICANCE.

notes_endorse: OPPOSED. EDITORIAL SAYS IT SHOULD BE VOTED DOWN. PROPOSED HAS BEEN DEFEATED IN FOUR DIFFERENT STATEWIDE REFERENDA WITHIN THREE YEARS. REPRESENTATIVE RANKIN FITE WAS TURNED OUT OF OFFICE BY MARION COUNTY VOTERS OVER THIS ISSUE.

prop_desc: AUTHORIZE MONTGOMERY COUNTY TO LEVY ADDITIONAL 5.5 MILLS AD VALOREM TAX FOR SCHOOL PURPOSES
notes_endorse: ENDORSED. PAPER RECOMMENDS A YES VOTE.

prop_desc: BRING MORE MORTGAGE MONEY INTO ALABAMA BY ALLOWING OUT-OF-STATE CORPORATIONS TO INVEST
notes_endorse: ENDORSED. COULD BRING AS MUCH AS $10 MILLION IN NEW MORTGAGE MONEY. WOULD INCREASE COMPETITION IN MORTGAGE FIELD.

prop_desc: AUTHORIZE TOWN OF UNIONTOWN TO DEAL IN REAL ESTATE AND CONSTRUCTION TO ATTRACT INDUSTRY
notes_endorse: OPPOSED. EDITORIAL QUESTIONS THE END THAT WOULD BE SERVED. CONCERNED ABOUT LOCAL GOVERNMENT ENGAGING IN ACTIVITIES THAT SHOULD BE LEFT TO PRIVATE ENTERPRISE.

prop_desc: LOCAL GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES
notes_endorse: ENDORSED. BESPEAKS EXTENDED OPPORTUNITIES FOR LOCAL GROWTH WHERE ENDORSED BY LOCAL AUTHORITY.

prop_desc: LOCAL GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES
notes_endorse: ENDORSED ALONGSIDE AMENDMENT 3.

prop_desc: ROANOKE SCHOOL DISTRICT FIVE-MILL PROPERTY TAX INCREASE FOR SCHOOL PURPOSES
notes_endorse: ENDORSED WITH 'UNQUALIFIED ENDORSEMENT.' ROANOKE NEEDS NEW HIGH SCHOOL BUILDING TO REPLACE CONDEMNED 50-YEAR-OLD STRUCTURE.

prop_desc: REDUCE RESIDENCY REQUIREMENT FOR VOTING IN ALABAMA ELECTIONS FROM TWO YEARS TO ONE YEAR IN STATE AND SIX MONTHS IN COUNTY

prop_desc: ALLOW COUNTY GOVERNING BODIES TO TRANSFER SURPLUS ROAD AND BRIDGE FUND REVENUE TO GENERAL FUND

prop_desc: MOUNTAIN BROOK - SPECIAL ELECTION TO DETERMINE IF ADDITIONAL PROPERTY TAX SHALL BE IMPOSED
notes_endorse: ENDORSED AS PART OF 'YES ON ALL FIVE' RECOMMENDATION.

notes_endorse: ENDORSED. 'AS WE HOPE IT WILL BE ALONG WITH THE OTHER FOUR.'

prop_desc: ALL PROPOSED CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENTS ON NOV 3 BALLOT
notes_endorse: OPPOSED ALL AMENDMENTS. EDITORIAL TITLED 'AMENDMENTS CONCERN US.' OBJECTS ON PRINCIPLE THAT AMENDMENTS AFFECT ONLY SINGLE COUNTIES BUT REQUIRE STATEWIDE RATIFICATION, DENYING LOCAL VOTERS THE RIGHT TO DECIDE. USES AMENDMENT 2 (ESCAMBIA COUNTY FEE SYSTEM TO SALARIES) AS EXAMPLE OF MIXED FEELINGS BUT CONCLUDES AGAINST ALL.

prop_desc: COVINGTON COUNTY - STATEWIDE VOTE ON LOCAL ISSUE
notes_endorse: OPPOSED. OBJECTS THAT STATEWIDE VOTERS MUST DECIDE LOCAL COVINGTON COUNTY ISSUE WITHOUT LOCAL REFERENDUM.

prop_desc: EDUCATION TAX AMENDMENT - INCOME TAX INCREASE FOR EDUCATION FUNDING
notes_endorse: STRONGLY ENDORSED. EDITORIAL TITLED 'A FAIR TAX, AT LAST!' CALLS IT FAIREST REVENUE MEASURE ALABAMA HAS SEEN IN AT LEAST A DECADE. AIMED AT TOP 11 PERCENT OF EARNERS. WOULD FUND JACKSONVILLE STATE UNIVERSITY AND LOCAL TRADE SCHOOLS.

prop_desc: LEGISLATIVE REFORM - ANNUAL SESSIONS, STAFF SUPPORT, INDEPENDENT PAY COMMISSION FOR LEGISLATOR SALARIES
notes_endorse: ENDORSED. 'WE SUPPORT AMENDMENT NO. 1 BECAUSE IT IS A SMALL STEP IN THE DIRECTION OF A MORE EFFECTIVE LEGISLATURE.' OPPOSES ASSOCIATED INDUSTRIES OF ALABAMA LOBBYISTS WHO ARE AGAINST IT.

prop_desc: LIQUOR REFERENDUM - WHETHER TO PERMIT LEGAL SALES AND CONSUMPTION OF LIQUOR BY INDIVIDUAL SERVINGS (BY THE DRINK) INSTEAD OF BY THE BOTTLE ONLY
notes_endorse: ENDORSED YES VOTE. 'WE BELIEVE DEEPLY THAT A YES VOTE TUESDAY WILL MEAN ONLY A VOTE TO PERMIT LEGAL SALES AND CONSUMPTION BY INDIVIDUAL SERVINGS INSTEAD OF BY THE LARGE BOTTLES.' ARGUES IT WOULD GENERATE NEEDED TAX REVENUE FOR CITY AND COUNTY.

prop_desc: PERSONALIZED AUTOMOBILE TAGS - ALLOWING PURCHASE OF PERSONALIZED LICENSE PLATES AT EXTRA COST ($13.50 PLUS $10)

prop_desc: PROPERTY TAX REFORM - AD VALOREM TAX RESTRUCTURING WITH ASSESSMENT RATES ON UTILITIES AT 30 PERCENT, BUSINESS AND NONRESIDENTIAL PROPERTY AT 30 PERCENT, AND FARM, FOREST AND RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY AT 10 PERCENT

LAW IS SO COMPLICATED AND VERBIAGE-ENCUMBERED EVEN ITS AUTHORS DON'T REALLY KNOW HOW IT WILL AFFECT ALABAMA TAXPAYERS. SHOULD BE SENT BACK TO LEGISLATURE FOR REWRITING.

notes_endorse: RECOMMENDS YES.
